Reaction ndi $\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, ne atomic masses H = 1, N = 14, uye inoenderera kusvikira chimwe chezvinopindura chapera. Ndeipi peya inopa nemazvo huremu (g) ye $\mathrm{NH_3}$ yakaumbwa nevhoriyamu yegasi rose riri muvessel mushure mereaction, yakashandurwa kuita standard temperature and pressure (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L), nenzira iyoyo?

chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.explain:

Nhanho 4: Gasi rose = 1.0 + 0.5 = 1.5 mol, vhoriyamu paSTP = 1.5 x 22.4 = 33.6 L.
Pindura: 17 g, 33.6 L (c). (Sarudzo dzisiri dzakarurama: 22.4 L inonyima H2 yasara; 34 g inosanganisa nhamba yemamole nema coefficients; 8.5 g inotora N2:NH3 se 1:1.)
